subject: Inbound traveler profiles, late arrivals & laundry/access requests
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Amy Kapoor <amy.kapoor@hilton-procure.com>, Pacific Event Services <events@pacificevent.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Inbound traveler profiles, late arrivals & laundry/access requests

Hi Amy / Events team —

We're finalizing on-site logistics for the Acme Financial executive workshop (June 15–17). A few items we need your confirmation on so we can communicate to attendees: 

1) Late/night arrivals: We have ~12 attendees arriving after 11:00pm on Tues 6/15 (red-eye flights). Can the front desk expedite late check-in and have keycards preprinted under the hotel block (block code RF-ACME-16)? We'll need a sign at the door and a dedicated check-in line if possible.

2) Express laundry access: Several executives requested same-day urgent laundry (suits). Can we confirm same-day laundry with a guaranteed pick-up before 10am and a stamped receipt for dry-clean service? If there's an out-of-hours dropbox procedure, please detail.

3) Bedding & accessibility: The attached attendee_profiles.xlsx has bed preferences and two mobility-restricted guests. We need two ground-floor or elevator-adjacent rooms (no stairs) and one rollaway/crib request. Please flag which room numbers will meet these needs.

4) Mini-fridge allergen policy: A couple of attendees are highly allergic — can you confirm that minibars can be cleared and replaced with allergy-safe snacks and a sealed mini-fridge on request?

5) Master bill: Acme will be on a master bill for meeting rooms and catering; room charges billed individually. Please prepare a preliminary masterbill_estimate.pdf so accounts can confirm GL codes.

I've cc'd Laura and Marissa to confirm VIP list and any internal allocations. Vivek — quick FYI on the late arrivals and shuttle timing below.

Attachments: attendee_profiles.xlsx

Thanks,
Monica
Monica Patel
Program Manager, Events & Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Amy Kapoor <amy.kapoor@hilton-procure.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Pacific Event Services <events@pacificevent.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Inbound traveler profiles, late arrivals & laundry/access requests

Hi Monica —

Thanks for the note and the attendee file. Quick answers inline below: 

1) Late/night arrivals — confirmed. We can preprint keycards for the block and hold them at a dedicated late-check-in desk (we'll put a signage packet and a liaison at the door). We'll need a final list 7 days prior for name matching; until then we'll hold by last name and company. Block code RF-ACME-16 will be reserved.

2) Express laundry — we offer overnight/dawn turnaround for dry-cleaning provided items are dropped by 10pm for next-day 10am return. For true same-day (drop by 8am, back by 6pm) we can do a rush fee; otherwise we recommend directing executives to our on-site pressing service. We'll include a sealed bag and stamped receipt process.

3) Bedding/accessibility — we can guarantee two elevator-adjacent rooms and a crib/rollaway. We will provide room numbers once we have the final rooming list; please note ADA rooms are limited so we'll hold provisional allocation until 6/1.

4) Mini-fridge — yes, we can clear minibars and provide sealed allergy-safe snack kits. We'll note allergies in the housekeeping profile on arrival.

5) Master bill — attached preliminary masterbill_estimate.pdf. Catering will be on a separate event invoice but can be consolidated if you prefer. 

Attachments: masterbill_estimate.pdf

Please send the attendee_list.csv with arrivals by time/station and any firm VIP assignments — that will let us block rooms and schedule staffing.

Best,
Amy Kapoor
Director, Sales & Events
Hilton Procurement Group

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Amy Kapoor <amy.kapoor@hilton-procure.com>, Pacific Event Services <events@pacificevent.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 07:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Inbound traveler profiles, late arrivals & laundry/access requests

Thanks Amy — that's helpful. Attendee list attached (CSV) — includes estimated arrival windows and a column for special requests. A few clarifications from our side: 

- VIPs (two execs) require guaranteed ground-floor adjacency and a guaranteed early continental breakfast delivered to the room at 5:30am on 6/16 and 6/17.
- One attendee (Michael Grant) will have a medical device and requires power access by the bed and a low-scent housekeeping policy. 
- We will need a temporary keycard bin at the back-of-house for shuttle drivers to pick up single-use passes for late arrivals (arrival manifest updated nightly).
- Can you confirm whether the hotel can hold one load of wash/dry for our on-site staff (a staff laundry credit) separate from guest services? That helps our event team out.

Attachments: attendee_list.csv

Laura / Marissa — please flag any other needs so I can finalize the list for Amy today.

Thanks,
Monica

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Inbound traveler profiles, late arrivals & laundry/access requests

Monica — quick notes: 

- Confirming both VIPs (Nathan Cole and Priya Natarajan) prefer queen beds pushed together vs. single king; please request connecting rooms if possible.
- Michael Grant (medical device) — I've added a note to onsite medical contact and will share power adapter on arrival.
- We'll take the staff laundry credit (one load) — logistics team will drop off at 9pm on 6/15.
- Shuttle: arrivals at 23:10 and 23:45 on 6/15 — suggest the dedicated late check-in desk be staffed until midnight at minimum.

Thanks — Laura

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Amy Kapoor <amy.kapoor@hilton-procure.com>, Pacific Event Services <events@pacificevent.com>, Jorge - Crowne Catering <jorge@crownecater.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: Acme workshop — late arrivals, keys, and on-site requests (room & staff logistics)

Amy / Team — consolidating final asks below and locking deadlines. Please confirm receipt and any outstanding constraints by EOD Wednesday 5/27 so we can publish the arrival instructions to attendees. 

Final asks: 
- Preprint keycards for RF-ACME-16 block; dedicated late-check-in desk through 12:30am on 6/15. Shuttle drivers to pick single-use passes from a back-of-house bin (we'll provide manifest nightly).
- Guaranteed two elevator-adjacent rooms and connecting rooms for the two VIPs (Nathan Cole, Priya Natarajan).
- Allergy-safe sealed mini-fridges and low-scent housekeeping for Michael Grant.
- Staff laundry credit: 1 load (drop-off 9pm 6/15).
- Early room service continental breakfast for VIPs at 5:30am on 6/16 & 6/17 (charge to master bill).
- Catering note to Jorge: please confirm individual boxed lunch options for 6/16 with nut-free labeling and vegetarian counts.

Attachments included for your reference: attendee_profiles.xlsx, attendee_list.csv, masterbill_estimate.pdf, venue_access_map.png. 

If anything here is not feasible, identify trade-offs (e.g., alternate breakfast timing, escort to late check-in) so we can surface to Acme.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — will publish arrival email once confirmed.

Best,
Monica Patel
Program Manager, Events & Ops
Redwood Inference
